2608.04565.title: Breadcrumbing Search Agents
2608.04565.paper_summary: LLM-based search agents are widely used for information-seeking tasks, but their reliance on external tool returns introduces a critical security risk: web content retrieved during execution is untrusted, exposing agents to prompt injection and goal hijacking. Prior work on search-agent safety primarily focuses on static web-content injection, but modern agents issue follow-up queries and cross-check competing sources, so a single injected page is often diluted or rejected. We show that the channel delivering search and page observations is a fragile security boundary: beyond exposing the agent to a single poisoned page, a mediated search interface can repeatedly steer how the agent gathers evidence and forms its final answer. Under a constrained tool-intermediary threat model, appending only one controlled result per query can substantially increase attack success when the evidence is coordinated across the agent's trajectory. We study this setting with a strategy-driven long-horizon attack system and introduce Authority-Chain Hijack (ACH), an expert-refined strategy that turns isolated search-result and page-content manipulations into a coherent evidence chain across seemingly corroborating sources. ACH achieves the highest Overall ASR among all baselines, reaching 55.9% / 83.3% ASR / MaxN ASR on the full SafeSearch test split. We further introduce Trace-Guided Strategy Evolution (TGSE), which automatically improves attacker strategies from execution traces, replacing manual redesign with trace-driven refinement; its strongest single setting reaches 71.4% / 95.0% in held-out evaluation.
2608.04565.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基於的搜尋代理廣泛用於資訊尋求任務，但它們對外部工具返回的依賴引入了一個關鍵的安全風險：執行期間檢索的網頁內容是不可信的，這使得代理面臨提示注入和目標劫持的風險。先前關於搜尋代理安全性的研究主要集中於靜態網頁內容注入，但現代代理會發出後續查詢並交叉檢查競爭來源，因此單一被注入的頁面往往會被稀釋或拒絕。我們顯示，傳遞搜尋和頁面觀察的通道是一個脆弱的安全邊界：除了使代理暴露於單一的被污染頁面之外，媒介搜尋介面可以重複引導代理如何收集證據並形成最終答案。在受限的工具中介威脅模型下，每次查詢僅附加一個受控結果可以在證據與代理的軌跡協調時顯著提高攻擊成功率。我們研究這一設定，使用一個策略驅動的長期攻擊系統，並引入權威鏈劫持（Authority-Chain Hijack, ACH），這是一種專家精煉的策略，將孤立的搜尋結果和頁面內容操控轉化為跨越看似相互證實來源的連貫證據鏈。ACH 在所有基準中實現了最高的整體 ASR，達到 55.9% / 83.3% ASR / MaxN ASR 在完整的 SafeSearch 測試分割上。我們進一步引入追蹤引導策略演化（Trace-Guided Strategy Evolution, TGSE），它自動從執行追蹤中改善攻擊者策略，將手動重新設計替換為基於追蹤的精煉；其最強的單一設置在保留評估中達到 71.4% / 95.0%。
